title: relay_queue orphan .msg files silently accumulate forever
description: relay_queue.rs drain_once scans only for .env files. enqueue writes .msg first (atomic rename), then .env (atomic rename). A crash between the two renames leaves a .msg without a .env. The drain never finds it (it only iterates .env files), so the message is silently dropped and the .msg file accumulates in the queue dir forever. The comment in enqueue claims 'the drain skips this .msg (no .env partner) and the file is retried on next startup scan' — this is incorrect. The drain does not scan for .msg files at all. Fix: either scan for orphan .msg files explicitly and move them to dead/, or write .env first then .msg (reversing write order) so that a .env without .msg is what the drain sees and can explicitly handle.
